कुठर

KUṬHARA . A prominent nāga. He was present among the nāgas, who went to receive balabhadra when he went, in the form of nāga, into the sea. (Mausala Parva, Chapter 4, Verse 15).

कुठार

KUṬHĀRA . A nāga born in Dhṛtarāṣṭra's family. It was burned to death at the serpent yajña of janamejaya. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 57, Verse 15).
